content.text: We need to select 2 units from possibleUnits. Units IDs:7,8,9,6,37. Must pick 2. Likely want to keep knights for future attacks. Units at greywater-watch: footman9, knight6, knight37. Also ship7 at port-of-pyke, ship8 also at port-of-pyke. Choose two knights (6,37) to keep army supply (supply 3, have 2 knights). So select those.

We need to resolve the march from Seagard. Options: move knights to one destination. No combat likely. Choose best move. We have knights at Seagard (6,37). Destinations list: Flint's Finger (already controlled), Greywater Watch (already), Moat Cailin (neutral), Pyke (own), Riverrun (neutral), The Twins (neutral). We want to expand towards castles. Nearest castle maybe Moat Cailin (castle level 1) neutral, or Pyke already ours. Moving to Moat Cailin would give us presence and possibly future attack on Winterfell? But Moat Cailin is neutral, no combat now. Could also move to The Twins (neutral). Aim to increase land area and eventually castles. Probably move both knights to Moat Cailin, leave power token at Seagard? We have power token there already? Seagard currently has no token. Leaving token gives control of Seagard which already has our knights anyway. But we are moving all units, must leave token true only if we left one. That's okay. So resolve_march to Moat Cailin.

Check constraints: each unit moved at most once, only one destination may trigger combat (none). Use listed destination. So call resolve_march with moves to Moat Cailin.

We need to submit orders for eligible regions. Likely choose actions. Provide assignments. Let's decide: we have knights at moat-cailin, footman at greywater-watch, ship at ironmans-bay, ship at port-of-pyke. Want to expand towards castle target maybe. Nearest castle is Moat Cailin is stronghold already. Could march from Moat Cailin to something? No knights there can march. Could march from Moat Cailin to... neighbours: greywater-watch, seagard, the-narrow-sea, the-twins, white harbor, winterfell. Might want to attack? No enemy units there except maybe none. Might want to support Greywater Watch defense. Also consolidate power at ironmans bay and port of pyke. So assignments: moat-cailin -> march (avoid starred) priority 100. ironmans-bay -> defense? but ship can't defend land? Actually defense order works for any unit in region, even ship? Probably yes. But better to use support at greywater-watch. Let's assign: moat-cailin march, ironmans-bay defense, port-of-pyke consolidate power, greywater-watch support. Provide priorities.

We need to resolve the march order for Moat Cailin. Options listed: reachable regions include Greywater Watch, Seagard, The Twins, White Harbor, Winterfell (combat). Must choose one. Likely want to move towards Winterfell to attack? We have 2 knights, Winterfell has 2 footmen (garrison 2) plus maybe defenders. Combat would be possible. Our knights 2 vs Winterfell defense +1 plus garrison 2 footmen. No support. Might lose. Better to move to Seagard (already our controlled) to consolidate? But we already have control token there? Seagard currently has control token (greyjoy). Leaving Moat Cailin could leave power token there (canLeavePowerToken true). Should we move to Greywater Watch to get support there? Greywater Watch currently has a footman ours, plus we have control token? No control token. Adding knights could strengthen. Also Greywater Watch adjacent to Moat Cailin, no combat. Probably best to move both knights to Greywater Watch to strengthen border and then later support. So resolve_march with destination Greywater Watch, leave power token true.

We need to choose a mustering action. Mustering options: from actionGuidance. We have points: musteringPoints 1 at flints-finger, moat-cailin; 2 at pyke, seagard. Must choose recruits within supply (supply 3, currently armies: greywater-watch has 3 units occupies army slot count 3 uses one of allowed sizes?). supply limit allowedArmySizes [3,2,2,2]; current armies list single army of 3 units uses size 3, leaves capacities for up to 3 more armies sizes 2 each. Must not exceed supply total units count? supply =3 means max total units =? Actually supply track indicates max total units across board = supply *? In AGoT supply is total units allowed = supply track value? Usually supply icons = max units. Greyjoy supply 3, currently have units: footman at greywater-watch (1), knights (2) =3 units total. Also have ships at ironmans-bay and port-of-pyke (2) and maybe others. Ships do not count toward supply? They do count toward supply? I think ships count toward supply limit as well but separate? In supply limit rule: singleUnitRegions are sea/port allowed one unit without using army slot. They still count against supply? Probably yes. So total units = 5. Supply 3 means max units =? Actually supply icons = max units across board. So we exceed? But they have supply 3 and 5 units, but allowed because ships maybe not count? In supplyLimit details: singleUnitRegions listed as ironmans-bay, port-of-pyke. rule: Only regions with two or more units use an army slot. So ships are single unit regions, not using army slot, but still count towards supply? Probably each unit consumes one supply token. So supply limit =3 means max units =3. But Greyjoy has 5 units, so maybe supply icons controlled =3 but they have more units because they've exceeded supply? Might be allowed but must not exceed supply when mustering new units; must respect supply limit. So can only muster if new units keep total <= supply? Currently they have 5 units; supply 3 implies they've overextended but maybe allowed because supply icons count only land units? Might be confusion. To be safe, mustering may be limited by supplySafeNewUnitsWhenChosenAlone values. For flints-finger, supplySafeNewUnitsWhenChosenAlone =2, meaning could muster up to 2 units if only action. So we can muster footmen/knight etc.

We should prioritize gaining castles: we already have 4 castles, need 7. Nearest castle? Probably Moat Cailin is a stronghold not castle. We could aim for Greywater Watch to get a castle? It's currently land with 0 castle. Castle target maybe need to control more castle areas. We could muster a footman in Moat Cailin to later move to capture? But we have armies.

We have mustering points: 2 at Seagard (castle) already we control? Seagard is castle level2, already ours. Mustering there can add footman/knight but no need. Might want to muster a footman at moats to later move north for expansion toward Winterfell? But time.

Probably safest: skip mustering to avoid exceeding supply. Use skip_mustering.

We need to place orders for the three eligible regions: ironmans-bay, port-of-pyke, greywater-watch. Must assign orders respecting restricted categories: defense is restricted, so cannot assign defense orders. We have to assign 3 orders. We have units: ironmans-bay has a ship unit. port-of-pyke ship. greywater-watch has footman and two knights. Options: march, support, raid, consolidate power. For ironmans-bay, likely march to move ship towards somewhere? Adjacent regions: flints-finger, greywater-watch, port-of-pyke, pyke, riverrun, seagard, sunset-sea, the-golden-sound. Could march ship to Seagard? But seagard already has our control token. Might want to support? Probably use march to move ship to Seagard to reinforce. For port-of-pyke, could consolidate power. For greywater-watch, support knights to aid defense or attack. No defense orders allowed. So support is okay. Let's assign: ironmans-bay -> march, priority high; greywater-watch -> support, priority medium; port-of-pyke -> consolidate_power, priority lower. No starred needed. Submit orders.

We need to resolve the march from ironman's bay. Options: destinations listed: port-of-pyke (no combat), sunset-sea, the-golden-sound (combat). Only one unit id 8 (ship) present. Can we leave power token? canLeavePowerToken false. So leave_power_token must be false. Must move all units if leaving token true, but can't. So we set leave_power_token false and choose a destination. Likely best to move ship to port-of-pyke to reinforce. No combat. So resolve_march with move to port-of-pyke, leave_power_token false.

Need to bid in bidding phase. We have 9 power tokens, need to consider value. Currently house has 4 VP, tied. Opponents: Lannister 4, Martell 4, others less. Winning requires 7 VP. Bidding influences tracks later. Probably bid low to conserve tokens. Minimal bid 0? Already submitted 0 earlier in round4. Now pendingDecision bids show tyrell bid -1 (meaning passed?). We can bid 0 or more. Probably bid 0 to keep tokens.

We need to make a decision: simple-choice between houses. Iron Throne holder must choose among lowest bidders. Current ironThrone track shows order: ["greyjoy","lannister","baratheon","stark","martell","tyrell"]; holder is Greyjoy. Need choose among lowest bidders. Who are lowest bidders? Not given but bids revealed earlier. Likely lowest bidders are those who bid 0? Probably all houses? But choices list includes all houses. As Iron Throne holder, we must pick one of the lowest bidders. Assume all houses tied low? Choose strategically: pick house we want to give Iron Throne? Might want to give to opponent weaker. Choose Tyrell (low power). So choose option index for "Tyrell". In choices array order: ["Tyrell","Greyjoy","Martell","Lannister"] index 0 is Tyrell. Use choose_option.
